meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: Binding ultrawork mode directive for omo on Codex. When a prompt contains ultrawork or ulw, the omo UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short bootstrap that points at this file. Read the whole file and follow every rule in it for the rest of the task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手进入受规则约束的工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要助手在长任务中严格执行预设规则
copy.tagline_en: Make the agent follow a strict set of rules for the rest of the task
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to enforce a rigid workflow on long, demanding AI interactions

howto.what: 装上后,当任务以 ultrawork 模式运行时,Claude 的回复首行会强制显示“ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”,然后先建立目标、明确成功标准、按轻重分级,写失败测试再实现,并用真实界面(HTTP/终端/浏览器等)验证,全程记录在记事本中。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 审查并修复登录接口的超时问题
say.note: 先建目标和失败测试,再真实 HTTP 验证

say.text: 以 ulw 模式给支付回调加鉴权
say.note: 按 HEAVY 标准处理,覆盖边界并走评审

say.text: 打开 ultrawork,重构 user 模块的跨域依赖
say.note: 先定位代码,再按计划执行并留证据

howto.what_en: In ultrawork mode, Claude must start with the exact line “ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”, then set goals, define success criteria, classify LIGHT/HEAVY, write failing tests first, verify via real surfaces (HTTP/terminal/browser/desktop), and log everything to a notepad.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the prompt contains “ultrawork” or “ulw”.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork to review and fix the login endpoint timeout.
say_en.note: Defines goals, writes a failing test, then verifies via real HTTP.

say_en.text: In ulw mode, add auth to the payment callback.
say_en.note: HEAVY tier: edge cases covered and a reviewer loop runs.

say_en.text: Enable ultrawork and refactor cross-domain deps in the user module.
say_en.note: Maps code first, then executes and records evidence.
